en.text: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 这事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长得罪了他们的主—埃及王，

zhTraditional.text: 這事以後，埃及王的酒政和膳長得罪了他們的主－埃及王，

en.text: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

zhSimplified.text: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这二臣，

zhTraditional.text: 法老就惱怒酒政和膳長這二臣，

en.text: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

zhSimplified.text: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。

zhTraditional.text: 把他們下在護衛長府內的監裏，就是約瑟被囚的地方。

en.text: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

zhSimplified.text: 护卫长把他们交给约瑟，约瑟便伺候他们；他们有些日子在监里。

zhTraditional.text: 護衛長把他們交給約瑟，約瑟便伺候他們；他們有些日子在監裏。

en.text: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

zhSimplified.text: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。

zhTraditional.text: 被囚在監之埃及王的酒政和膳長二人同夜各做一夢，各夢都有講解。

en.text: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

zhSimplified.text: 到了早晨，约瑟进到他们那里，见他们有愁闷的样子。

zhTraditional.text: 到了早晨，約瑟進到他們那裏，見他們有愁悶的樣子。

en.text: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

zhSimplified.text: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说：「你们今日为什么面带愁容呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 他便問法老的二臣，就是與他同囚在他主人府裏的，說：「你們今日為甚麼面帶愁容呢？」

en.text: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们对他说：「我们各人做了一梦，没有人能解。」约瑟说：「解梦不是出于 神吗？请你们将梦告诉我。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們對他說：「我們各人做了一夢，沒有人能解。」約瑟說：「解夢不是出於上帝嗎？請你們將夢告訴我。」

en.text: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

zhSimplified.text: 酒政便将他的梦告诉约瑟说：「我梦见在我面前有一棵葡萄树，

zhTraditional.text: 酒政便將他的夢告訴約瑟說：「我夢見在我面前有一棵葡萄樹，

en.text: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

zhSimplified.text: 树上有三根枝子，好像发了芽，开了花，上头的葡萄都成熟了。

zhTraditional.text: 樹上有三根枝子，好像發了芽，開了花，上頭的葡萄都成熟了。

en.text: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄挤在法老的杯里，将杯递在他手中。」

zhTraditional.text: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄擠在法老的杯裏，將杯遞在他手中。」

en.text: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟对他说：「你所做的梦是这样解：三根枝子就是三天；

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟對他說：「你所做的夢是這樣解：三根枝子就是三天；

en.text: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

zhSimplified.text: 三天之内，法老必提你出监，叫你官复原职，你仍要递杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一样。

zhTraditional.text: 三天之內，法老必提你出監，叫你官復原職，你仍要遞杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一樣。

en.text: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

zhSimplified.text: 但你得好处的时候，求你记念我，施恩与我，在法老面前提说我，救我出这监牢。

zhTraditional.text: 但你得好處的時候，求你記念我，施恩與我，在法老面前提說我，救我出這監牢。

en.text: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

zhSimplified.text: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来的；我在这里也没有做过什么，叫他们把我下在监里。」

zhTraditional.text: 我實在是從希伯來人之地被拐來的；我在這裏也沒有做過甚麼，叫他們把我下在監裏。」

en.text: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

zhSimplified.text: 膳长见梦解得好，就对约瑟说：「我在梦中见我头上顶着三筐白饼；

zhTraditional.text: 膳長見夢解得好，就對約瑟說：「我在夢中見我頭上頂着三筐白餅；

en.text: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

zhSimplified.text: 极上的筐子里有为法老烤的各样食物，有飞鸟来吃我头上筐子里的食物。」

zhTraditional.text: 極上的筐子裏有為法老烤的各樣食物，有飛鳥來吃我頭上筐子裏的食物。」

en.text: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟说：「你的梦是这样解：三个筐子就是三天；

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟說：「你的夢是這樣解：三個筐子就是三天；

en.text: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

zhSimplified.text: 三天之内，法老必斩断你的头，把你挂在木头上，必有飞鸟来吃你身上的肉。」

zhTraditional.text: 三天之內，法老必斬斷你的頭，把你掛在木頭上，必有飛鳥來吃你身上的肉。」

en.text: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他为众臣仆设摆筵席，把酒政和膳长提出监来，

zhTraditional.text: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他為眾臣僕設擺筵席，把酒政和膳長提出監來，

en.text: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

zhSimplified.text: 使酒政官复原职，他仍旧递杯在法老手中；

zhTraditional.text: 使酒政官復原職，他仍舊遞杯在法老手中；

en.text: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

zhSimplified.text: 但把膳长挂起来，正如约瑟向他们所解的话。

zhTraditional.text: 但把膳長掛起來，正如約瑟向他們所解的話。

en.text: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

zhSimplified.text: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。

zhTraditional.text: 酒政卻不記念約瑟，竟忘了他。
